notes.title: v1.04a
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed:

 Gamepad--Interface overlap when trying to perform an action with the Interaction (Y) button from the inventory while near a Bloodstone.
 Tutorial button visuals overlapping with each other in the prologue.
 Jump boost points in certain areas not propelling the player high enough.


For feedback or reporting issues: volviirdev@gmail.com

notes.title: v1.04
notes.content:
Player can now use the dodge move during an attack, allowing them to cancel the attack animation. Additionally, player can change direction mid-attack, so they can adjust which way to face when canceling an attack if needed.

 Invincibility duration gained during a dodge has been increased.

 Enemies now track the player less precisely during an attack, giving the player a better chance to avoid incoming strikes.

 Jumping and wall-jumping have been improved, providing a smoother feel.

 Some translation errors have been corrected.

 Minor visual enhancements.


For feedback or reporting issues: volviirdev@gmail.com

notes.title: v1.03 - Controller Support, Brightness Settings and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Controller Support (Xbox)
Xbox controller support and interface icons have been added. (There might be issues in some cases; please report any problems via email.)

Brightness, Contrast, and Saturation Settings
You can make visual adjustments by pressing the "Brightness Settings" button in the options menu. (Due to an issue, these settings revert to default when you restart the game; will fix this in a future update.)

 Minor bugs and interface errors have been fixed.


For assistance or to report bugs, please email: blodfestgames@gmail.com

notes.title: v1.02
notes.content:
Amount of Rage lost per second in demon form has been slightly increased.
 Damage of Judgement and Hellfire skills in demon form has been slightly increased.
 Azurith's health has been increased slightly.
 A bug preventing the achievement from being awarded after defeating a specific boss has been fixed.
 Minor UI bug during the dialogue with Evelyn has been fixed.
 Minor UI bug during the dialogue with Valu'ur has been fixed.
 Minor UI bugs in the Bloodstone menu has been fixed.
 Evelyn's hitbox have been corrected.
 Valu'ur's hitbox have been corrected.
 Hitbox of the mobs in Red Maple Forest have been corrected.
 A bug preventing interaction with a treasure spot in the Realm of Torment has been fixed.
 Some missing items in Realm of Torment have been added to the game.
 Some missing items in Bloody Harbor have been added to the game.
 Arothar's name under the Interaction Text have been corrected.
 Stunned state animation of Erebos has been fixed.
 Fixed an issue where some unparryable or undodgeable attacks would deal damage to player when Thorne transforming into demon form or returning to human form.
 If Thorne is still in demon form in the cutscene after boss battle, he will transform into human form.
 Fixed a bug that prevented game progression after defeating Azurith.


For assistance or to report bugs, please email: blodfestgames@gmail.com

notes.title: v1.01c

For assistance or to report bugs, please email: blodfestgames@gmail.com

notes.title: v1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an interface bug that occurred after talking to the Master Blacksmith.
 Fixed an issue preventing quest rewards from being given if the Stranger's dialogue was skipped after completion.
 Increased the damage dealt by Forgotten Hunter, Narkul, Baelgor, and Zephros slightly.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the Hellsword and Demonsword from working in certain situations.
 Various translation adjustments.
 Visual improvements.
 Fixed several issues in the dialogue with the Witch.
 Fixed a bug preventing the reset of Hellfire and Judgement during skill tree reset.


Known Bugs:

 It appears that Master Blacksmith is experiencing a slight memory lapse - constantly. Every time you teleport to the Sanctuary, the dialogues reset to the beginning. We will fix this issue as soon as possible.


For assistance or to report bugs, please email: blodfestgames@gmail.com
